newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends slightly up in range trading.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends slightly up in range trading.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES -The market was a shade higher but trading continued rangebound as interest remained absent. Prices drifted in a seven ringgit range. Uncertainty in fundamental outlook also limited activity. Trading was sluggish and June futures - resistance at 1,255 with support at 1,230.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The market saw little participation with prices holding at around overnight levels.
"Elsewhere, oil products were also hardly moved and cash prices were little traded as players were just sitting at the sidelines," the trader added.
"There is still a lot of uncertainty in the market about fundamental outlook. Exports look good this month but supply is increasing gradually," a trader said.

"Technically, rangebound trading is still intact and the market is likely to trade between 1,235 and 1,255 ringgit a tonne (June futures) unless some leads appear," another trader said. June futures closed three ringgit higher at 1,240 ringgit ($500.60) a tonne.
Turnover on the futures market was 611 lots.
Among physicals March (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,282.50 ringgit against bids of 1,280 after trading at 1,282.50.
March (central) saw offers at 1,270 against bids of 1,265 and March (north) at 1,255 against 1,245.
Apr (south) was offered at 1,282.50 with bids at 1,280 with early transactions 1,282.50 and 1,280 and Apr (central) at 1,270 against 1,265.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $540 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May $537.50, June at $532.50 and July/Aug/Sept at $530. Apr was traded at $539.
Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $577.50, May at $572.50, Jun at $567.50 and July/Aug/Sept at 562.50. May was traded at $567.50 and $569.
Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $435 and Apr palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $300.
